premises.text: 5.4 billion people do not have smartphones and rely on SMS for communication
premises.evidence_span: there are 5.4 billion non-smartphones on the Earth right now

premises.text: SMS is not an intuitive or visually appealing way to communicate
premises.evidence_span: how ugly an SMS looks like before iPhone came along. It wasn't threaded. It wasn't intuitive.

premises.text: People in emerging economies spend a significant portion of their income on messaging
premises.evidence_span: people spend up to 5% of their monthly income on just messaging

premises.text: An app can beautify SMS and reduce its cost for non-smartphone users
premises.evidence_span: we wanted to solve two problems, beautify SMS and cut the cost of SMS for people without non-smartphones drastically

premises.text: Users can send threaded messages and create groups on non-smartphones
premises.evidence_span: users are able to send threaded iPhone-like threaded messaging on non-smartphones to their phone contacts

premises.text: The app allows location services on non-smartphones
premises.evidence_span: we bring location to non-smartphones, phones that don't have GPS

premises.text: The app has a large user base and demand, evidenced by downloads and invitations
premises.evidence_span: Within two months, we had 400,000 downloads of a beta app

premises.text: The app monetizes through advertisements, which are seen as informational in emerging economies
premises.evidence_span: we monetize with advertisement. I know ads are not in here. But we, in emerging economies, don't have access to information.

premises.text: The platform aims to provide internet access and services to non-smartphone users
premises.evidence_span: I see SEIA as a platform that is going to bring internet access to people to have stuff like Yelp, iTunes, shopping on their non-smartphones

value.text: Non-smartphone users gain access to enhanced messaging and internet services
value.evidence_span: we are solving an SMS problem right now

notes: Fundraising and conference details excluded as traction.
